title: Gear, version 1
description: A file under content/gear/ (work order 010, scope 3). A top-level id of the form gear.<zone>.<name>, so the register can hold the file (work order 010 names no id; without one a gear file would have no content id and no register row). 'gear' lists one entry per gear item: item, the id of an item under content/items/; slot, weapon or armour (combat.json gear.loadout); style, melee, marksmanship or aetherics, weapons only; level_required, the style level to equip a weapon or the Fortitude level to wear armour (combat.json gear.weapon.fields, gear.armour.fields); stats_by_calibration, exactly 21 rows, +0 to +20. A weapon row is {calibration, power, accuracy}, power in the model's x10 units; an armour row is {calibration, armour}. Rows +1 to +20 may be null while the calibration step is open. Rules this subset of JSON Schema cannot say (row n has calibration n, row +0 is not null, which fields a slot needs, style only on weapons, one entry per item) are checked by scripts/validate/check_combat.py.
